svg.title: Flash Sale System architecture
svg.desc: A React single-page app calls a stateless Spring Boot backend. Purchases pass a rate limiter and an atomic Redis Lua reservation, then an order event goes to Kafka; a consumer writes the order to PostgreSQL. Payment, an expiry sweeper and reconciliation update PostgreSQL and Redis. Prometheus scrapes metrics for Grafana.
svg.text: Redis-gated purchases • Event-driven orders • Database-enforced invariants • Never oversells
Spring Boot 4 · Java 25 virtual threads · stateless, scales to N instances
PURCHASE PATH · touches only Redis and Kafka
compare-and-set status updates · close unpaid orders, release stock · read for drift
